findings.label: Repeated identical failure message
findings.detail: TaskList.vue watch(() => page.props.flash?.error) compares by value, so a second consecutive failure with the identical error string won't re-fire the toast. Pre-existing value-compare watcher characteristic, not introduced by this change; only affects an exact repeat. Could later key off a nonce or clear the flash after display.

findings.label: post_max_size path manually-verified only
findings.detail: The PostTooLargeException handler in bootstrap/app.php can't be reproduced in the test suite without php.ini config; evidence correctly flags it as needs-manual-verification. Handler is registered, scoped to non-api web requests, and builds. Recommend a one-time manual check with a small post_max_size.
